summary: Adds a read-only CLI preview of the official reserve-workflows catalog through the permanent RESERVE workflow API.
highlights: Adds reserve workflow browse commands for the complete catalog or one collection
Adds reserve workflow get for versioned official workflow YAML retrieval
Uses the permanent https://api.reservecli.dev/v1 API boundary with table, JSON, and raw YAML output
Keeps the preview read-only and separate from local workflow installation or execution
Defers verified-email enrollment, FRED-key validation, RESERVE tokens, and authenticated access to v1.2.3
update_instructions: Download the latest release from the GitHub releases page or rerun the install script from download.reservecli.dev.
